# What the completed exhibition left behind

The harbour archive gets a steady trickle of withdrawal questions and school enquiries. Its launch is over; its obligations are smaller and continuing. The registrar has handled them without involving the original team. That is a successful handover, not evidence that the project was forgotten. Keep [[Exhibition plan]] archived and make the contact information easy to find.
